title: WebP Studio
author: Seth Morrow
description: Pictures and animations written, read and played, live, by the webpxt extension. It plays by itself: a picture written into smaller and smaller WebP files beside the original, written without loss and read back the same to the last pixel, cut into a window you can see through, and thirty frames written into one animated file and played back from it. Then it is your turn: open a picture or an animation of your own, choose how it is written, drag the line to compare, and save the WebP file.
